translations.web: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
translations.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
translations.kjv: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
translations.asv: But she answered and saith unto him, Yea, Lord; even the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
